description: Constitutional Lock Registry (PHASE G.2, WS2/WS7). Maps constitutional closures (REAL-C-03/04/05) to release locks. The Constitutional Lock Engine computes each lock's state (OPEN | LOCKED | EXTERNAL_LOCKED | RELEASED) from the closure verdict and the external-blocker model. A lock is only RELEASED when evidence satisfies the closure criteria (closure verdict GO); a lock backed by an external blocker computes EXTERNAL_LOCKED and cannot be released by software. Append-only / migration-only per INV-10. This registry releases no lock and closes nothing.

releaseConditions: Independent adjudicator model established with registered keys (G1 + G2)

Retroactive AD-0016..0023 enrollment confirmed on canonical AUTH-012 ledger

Required evidence EV-REAL-C-05, EV-PI8-RAT, EV-PI9-RAT at >= VERIFIED via independent attestation

locks.note: PERMANENTLY external. Independence (proposer != attestor) cannot be satisfied by the authoring/construction chain or by any software agent. Self-closure forbidden (SIG-5).
